$comment: The Rock releases the release workflow builds packages for (decision 127): one for each supported Rock major release, its newest dot release. A package serves every dot release of its major (decision 52), so the workflow checks out each ref from SparkDevNetwork/Rock, builds it, writes and verifies every dataset's package on it, and publishes them under packages/v{tag}/rock-{major}/. 'ref' is a release tag once Rock tags the release, or a full commit hash before then. The workflow refuses a ref whose Directory.Build.props has a different version, and two entries for one major.

releases.$comment: Rock 21.0.2 has no release tag yet. This is develop on 2026-10-21, the commit the packages were last verified on. Change it to the tag "21.0.2" once Rock publishes it.

Rock 20.0.10 has no release tag yet. This is release-20.0 on 2026-10-23, where every package passed verify. Its schema matches Rock 21.0.2's exactly. Change it to the newest Rock 20 tag once Rock publishes one.
